name: Md. Sabbir Ahmmed Shuvo
headline: Computer Science and Engineering student at Daffodil International University.
intro: I work with Java and SQL, and I am learning cybersecurity.
about:
I am a Computer Science and Engineering student at Daffodil International University in Dhaka, Bangladesh, currently in my 7th semester. My university journey began in 2024, and I expect to graduate in 2028.

I am developing my programming, database and software development skills through coursework and academic projects. My strongest area is SQL, and I am at a beginner level in Java and C. I have used Java and MySQL in two academic projects: a team-based resort management system and an individual fitness assistant.

My interests are software development, database systems and cybersecurity. I am learning cybersecurity through courses and learning resources, and I see it as a developing interest rather than an area of expertise. I also work part-time at JPLANT as a Senior Employee, Moderator and Mentor.
degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Engineering
